name: Add a smartwatch line to an existing phone line
description: Offers checked on att.com/buy/phones and att.com/bundles/internet-wireless on 2026-11-25. Customer voice: curious, polite.
scripted_messages: Hello! I already have an AT&T phone line and I'd like to add an Apple Watch with cellular. The plan page says wearables are $10.99 a month. Can you tell me how adding it works, and whether any Premium 2.0 discount applies to it?
Thank you. Does it share my phone number?
And is there an activation fee for the watch line?
Is the 50 percent off on Premium 2.0 for the watch line?
Wonderful, that's all clear. You were lovely and really helpful, thank you.
No, that's all. Have a great day, bye!
_expected_agent_flow: before message 1: agent: greeting, asks for first and last name
before message 2: agent: welcomes the customer, asks how they can help
before message 3: agent: 'please give me a moment' while checking
before message 4: agent: gives the answer/quote
before message 5: agent: answers the previous question
before message 6: agent: answers the follow-up
before message 7: agent: gives the detail / the calculated bill
before message 8: agent: 'Is there anything else I can help you with today?'
